title: Fmpz Exact Call Graph
objective: Extend the internal FLINT fmpz backend across a closed native helper call graph with bool and tuple results, demonstrated by a representative promoted exact-arithmetic witness without adding IntegerBuffer or broader FFI support

handoff.summary: The FLINT fmpz backend now qualifies an acyclic closed exact program consisting of one arena-owning root and its reachable scalar-only helpers. Integer, uint64, bool, scalar, and tuple results have a direct internal fmpz ABI, native.call lowering never crosses through mpz_t, and separately host-called helpers retain a checked public GMP bridge. The four-function witness differentially exercises small, negative-floor-division, 256-bit, and 4096-bit values and proves generated helper/root bodies contain neither mpz operations nor fmpz-mpz conversions.
risks: Automatic selection remains fail-closed to one unbounded-vector arena root plus scalar-only acyclic helpers; this lane intentionally does not qualify IntegerBuffer, borrowed resident vector/matrix parameters, or additional FLINT resources.

Linux x64 compilation and runtime were exercised locally. The source uses only existing portable FLINT and generated-C ABI types, but Linux arm64, macOS arm64, Windows x64, and Wasm execution remain integration-lane validation.
architecture:check and test:changed reach the inherited stale optimizer-opportunity manifest (expected b7b3aa1f, found 4f6cafa7) after all preceding architecture checks pass.

test:native passes all correctness, sanitizer, lifecycle, compiler, production-pack, and migration stages, then the unrelated dense ZZ select_columns_500 performance ratchet measures 3.22 ms against a 3.00 ms shared-host budget.
next_steps: Add a resident fmpz IntegerBuffer ingress/view with get, set, and length so the cubic root's thirteen packed exact parameters cross the host boundary once instead of per element.
Extend the direct fmpz helper ABI to borrowed NativeIntegerVector and FmpzMatrix parameters while preserving owner lifetime and alias proofs.
Lower the remaining cubic closure operations: integer.mod_uint64, loop.range_exact, and uint64.from_integer_checked (IntegerBuffer operations are covered by the ingress step).

Qualify the thirteen additional cubic FLINT/resource declarations: HNF/LLL/SNF matrix operations, fmpz polynomial construction/sealing, logarithm-ball resources, and number-field analysis/project resources.

Re-run selection on the 73-function certified_complex_cubic_class_group_v1 closure, inspect generated C for zero hot-path mpz conversions, then differential-test receipts before enabling automatic fmpz dispatch.
